title: Our Best Reviews Include Warnings
why: Bookers comparing tours: real recent Google reviews that admit the hard parts (tired arms, tandems, rain), which makes the praise believable.
hook_options: Five-star guests who told the whole truth.
Read the fine print in our reviews.
caption: Some of our favorite five-star reviews come with a warning attached. Tired arms by the last 40 minutes. Tandems by default. Lightning cancels. We'd rather you book knowing all of it. 4.9 stars across 1,408 Google reviews. #SwampTour #NewOrleans #KayakTour #NOLA

slides.headline: Our best reviews include warnings.
slides.body: Five-star guests who told the truth about tired arms, tandems and weather. Read them before you book.

slides.headline: "By the last 40 min I was worn out!"
slides.body: She's 36 and in good shape. It's two hours of real paddling, with drift stops. Plan your energy.

slides.headline: Easy pace. Real paddling.
slides.body: Flat water, a guide setting the pace, 2 or 3 drift stops. Still, eat breakfast and bring water.

slides.headline: "Cool facts balanced with quiet paddling."
slides.body: Her one wish was a single kayak. Two people who book together get a tandem by default. Worth knowing.

slides.headline: "Surprisingly there were very few mosquitos."
slides.body: Lucky week. Mosquito season runs roughly April through October, so pack the spray anyway.

slides.headline: "Whenever there is lightning they have to cancel."
slides.body: True. Light rain, we paddle. Lightning, we don't. He also noticed gators get less active on rainy days.

slides.headline: "I'm scared of spiders and snakes and all that."
slides.body: She came anyway, and wrote that her guide made her feel safe as could be. Tell yours you're nervous.

slides.headline: "Didn't want to go on this tour (wife's idea)."
slides.body: His verdict after: a stellar time, 100% recommend. Bring your skeptic.

slides.headline: Tired arms. Tandems. Rain rules. Still five stars.
slides.body: We'd rather you book knowing all of it. 4.9 stars across 1,408 Google reviews.

slides.headline: Read the reviews. Then come paddle.
slides.body: Small-group kayak swamp tours from New Orleans. Send this to the skeptic in your group.
